name: 19518 · Douglassville, PA
findings: ZIP 19518 (Douglassville) has 50 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 20 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19518 (Douglassville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19518 (Douglassville) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
